title: Optimus Server
body:
![Header - Optimus Server - A better vanilla plus experience](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e8c724d59844dc47560eabdf21f81bd74c82837.png)

## ⁉️ Why Optimus? **🔥 Blazing fast performance** Optimus is based on Adrenaline, onme of the greatest performance packs available. It greatlty improves minecraft's performance by default, and Optimus goes further to add a few mods not bundled by default **📦 Everything you need is already prepackaged** Just install and go! Optimus provides a great lenght of QoL server-side tweaks, whilst keeping maximum performance. **🩵 Made with love.** Optimus is a passion project, born long before the first public release. I've been building performance modpacks for 7 years (due to tremendous need lol), and Optimus itself was born 3 years ago. 2026 marks the first timee i'm porting Optimus to the server **✒️ Good design.** Come on, don't you love the blue arrows?! **❔ Why not just use Spigot/Paper/Purpur?** While they do offer great performance, Spigot and it's forks are known to modify a lot of vanilla features, leading mostly to broken farms, specially those who heavily rely on redstone. **➕ What are the QoL features added?** Paired with [Optimus Client](https://modrinth.com/modpack/optimus): - [Hunger-related improvements](https://modrinth.com/mod/EsAfCjCV), allowing you to preview hunger and saturation from foods and actually seing your current saturation; - [Performance profiling](https://modrinth.com/mod/spark) - [Avoid server crashes due to TickingEntity errors](https://modrinth.com/mod/neruina) - [Discord synchronization](https://modrinth.com/plugin/dcintegration) - [Client blocking](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientblock) - [Paper's Anti X-Ray](https://modrinth.com/mod/anti-xray) - [Webmap](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bluemap) - Ability to [revert controversial game changes](https://modrinth.com/mod/nJxEs2tZ) - The basics: - [WAILA/HWYLA/WTHIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/6AQIaxuO) - [NEI/JEI/REI](https://modrinth.com/mod/nfn13YXA) - [Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/1bokaNcj) and [World map](https://modrinth.com/mod/NcUtCpym) **The list goes on; play to check everything out!** ## ℹ️ Still unsure? Check the wiki (coming soon!) ## 👤 Credits **Mod credits are featured on each version's dependency list.**
